metadata.title: Eric Pastor — Software Developer, Mobile Apps & AI
metadata.description: Eric Pastor, software developer in Tarragona and Basalt Works founder. Web, mobile, AI agents, automation and internal tools in an interactive Y2K desktop.

hero.description: <accent>Software developer</accent> turning ideas into interactive experiences — and founder of <accent>Basalt Works</accent>, where I build websites, AI automations and internal tools for businesses.

about.title: About Me
about.description1: My job consists of transforming complex problems into efficient and elegant software solutions. As a developer, my passion doesn't only lie in writing clean code, but in building the tool that each project needs.
about.description2: In 2025 I founded <accent>Basalt Works</accent>, my own software development and automation agency. There I build modern websites, AI automations and internal tools for businesses, and I help them simplify their day-to-day processes.
about.description3: I keep myself in constant learning, actively exploring from web and mobile development to artificial intelligence, which allows me to bring a comprehensive and updated vision to each challenge.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of client work and personal projects.

basaltworks.title: Basalt Works
basaltworks.description: Website for my software development and automation agency. High-tech industrial aesthetic, presenting services from modern websites to AI automations and internal tools.

primehomes.title: PrimeHomes Operations Agent
primehomes.description: AI operations agent for a real estate business, running on a Hetzner VPS. Built with Hermes and custom skills and workflows, it cut document handling from 5 hours a week to 90 minutes (-70%). Reachable through WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord.

spindone.title: SpinDone
spindone.description: A local-first productivity app that turns configured work and leisure activities into weighted, time-blocked daily or weekly plans through a playful spin mechanic.

animalgacha.title: Animal Gacha
animalgacha.description: A local-first wildlife card collector where players open packs, build a 300-animal collection grounded in real conservation data, and use their cards in turn-based PvE combat.

dungeonquiz.title: Dungeon Quiz
dungeonquiz.description: A quiz roguelike in which correct answers power turn-based combat through procedurally generated dungeon floors, enemies, bosses, loot, and persistent character progression.

gaelsantano.title: Gael Santano
gaelsantano.description: Portfolio and storefront for a custom fashion designer. Built with Next.js and Tailwind, using Shopify as the commerce backend.

cydservicios.title: CyD Servicios
cydservicios.description: Corporate website for a construction company with over 20 years of experience. The design reflects solidity and trust, showcasing their comprehensive services and extensive portfolio.

icoreven.title: ICOREVEN
icoreven.description: Corporate website for a renovation and investment business, redesigned with Astro and Tailwind. Dual focus: attracting investors and capturing clients for their renovation services, with SEO and copywriting.

sketchpad.title: Sketchpad
sketchpad.description: An online drawing pad to unleash your creativity. Draw, color and export your creations.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Have a project in mind or just want to say hello? I'd be happy to hear from you. Let's create something amazing together!

footer.designed: Designed and developed by Eric Pastor
